title: Algorithmic Harms Associated with Generative Model-Augmented Recommendation Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution (e.g., 'Ali' vs. 'Michael') in travel tip recommendation prompts to observe disparate assumptions about financial stability, connectivity, and visa requirements.
Providing demographic profiles (age, occupation, location) in cold-start item recommendation prompts to observe whether the model relies on stereotypes to infer gender for fashion recommendations.

Prompting the model with varying demographic personas (e.g., older male farmer in Oklahoma vs. younger female freelancer in California) to observe stereotypic inferences regarding political affiliation in autobiography recommendations.

Analyzing query refinement outputs for prompts mentioning physical attributes (e.g., 'tall women', 'short men', 'fat women') to detect unsolicited, stereotypic, or body-shaming advice like weight loss or height-increasing diets.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating query refinement suggestions for inputs related to LGBTQ+ individuals (e.g., 'transgender woman', 'gay wedding') to identify stereotyping, unwarranted medical inferences, and exoticization.

Evaluating image alt-text generation across different demographic groups to observe 'othering' and semantic misalignment (e.g., explicitly labeling marginalized groups with terms like 'diverse skin tones' while treating white subjects as an unmarked default).
